claim_boundary: The baseline proves Isaac Sim physics, RTX rendering, CUDA compute, and a genuinely multi-frame video on the recorded host. Candidate rows prove only the named task, exact commit, reset/step count, and visual capture. Under the noncommercial_academic_local_use policy, every technical runtime pass is admitted for local academic use and license findings are advisory rather than runtime blockers. Strict open-source closure remains a separate provenance fact, and this package does not redistribute third-party assets.

conditions: Materialize 472 Git LFS objects; the retained assets manifest contains 471 files.
Provide zarr==3.1.5, numcodecs==0.16.5, donfig==0.8.1.post1, and google-crc32c==1.7.1 in an isolated overlay without replacing the baseline Torch stack.
Use the bounded AgenticSim harness for reset, ten task steps, three native camera frames, and clean shutdown without starting the data-writer controller.
remaining_blockers: The required data assets are CC BY-NC 4.0 and explicitly limited to research and educational use, so this is not an unrestricted open-source runtime closure.
The upstream --headless argument is parsed but ignored by a hardcoded headless=False launch configuration.
The upstream default config name does not match any config filename.
The original controller factory eagerly imports local policy dependencies even in collect mode.
An external timeout of the original parallel HDF5 writer can terminate inside native signal handling; the bounded harness avoids that shutdown path.
